baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction haqqa al-qawlu 'ala at words 2-4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The word is not merely spoken; haqq supplies fixed obligation and qawl supplies articulated content, so the construction presents a pronouncement as now binding upon its objects.

activation_trace.role: Fixed obligation makes the word due and borne rather than merely true in the abstract.
Articulated speech supplies the content that crosses into binding force.

changed_reading.before: A statement has been made about most of them.
changed_reading.after: A pronouncement has become binding upon most of them, with their nonbelief presented as its attached result.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence haqq, qawl, then la yu'minun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Haqq aligns the word with established reality while iman names heart-settled assent; their juxtaposition exposes a gap between what is objectively established and what most subjects inwardly ratify.

activation_trace.role: Reality-matching fixity supplies the objective pole of the contrast.
Qawl as held position lets the word operate at the level of conviction as well as utterance.
Heart-settled assent names the subjective response that fails to meet established reality.

changed_reading.before: Most simply fail to accept a message.
changed_reading.after: A reality-aligned word stands fixed while most hearts fail to settle into assent to it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive scale word aktharihim at word 5 before fa-hum la yu'minun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Numerical preponderance, not totality, scopes the following nonbelief. The verse therefore creates a dominant bloc while grammatically preserving a remainder outside that state.

activation_trace.role: Growth of number marks the affected group as a majority rather than the whole.
Numerical dominance explains why the majority can characterize the group without exhausting it.
The denied assent is assigned specifically to the numerically dominant partition.

changed_reading.before: The addressed people are uniformly unbelieving.
changed_reading.after: Nonbelief characterizes the dominant partition, while the wording deliberately leaves a responsive minority possible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coupling of haqq with al-qawl.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch of authoritative, effective say and the branch of establishing truth allow qawl to function as a speech-act: its force lies in making a state hold, not only in describing one.

activation_trace.role: The effective say of an authoritative speaker gives qawl operative force.
Establishing and manifesting truth turns that force into an accomplished state.

changed_reading.before: The word reports that most will not believe.
changed_reading.after: The word operates as an effective determination whose becoming established and the majority's state are joined.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel translates fixed non-assent into a coupled bodily and perceptual system: the neck is restrained, routes before and behind are closed, and sight cannot acquire an opening.

activation_trace.role: Binding fixity is the focus mechanism that the sequel gives bodily form.
Failed heart-assent is the focus state externalized by the spatial images.
A collar restraining an organ makes closure bodily and fixes the subject's posture.
Filled breaches and barriers on both sides remove routes of revision or escape.
Literal sight is the evidence channel closed at the end of the spatial sequence.

structural_cues: 36:8-10 immediately unfold the focus's fa-hum pattern as restraint, non-sight, and a repeated la yu'minun.
36:9 places barriers both before and behind the same plural subjects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collars, bidirectional barriers, and non-sight; I infer that sequence as an enacted mechanism of fixed nonbelief. A live alternative is that these are parallel consequences of the word rather than causes of the failure to assent.

changed_reading.before: The binding word and nonbelief form a bare verdict.
changed_reading.after: The verdict is imaged as a self-enclosing posture in which movement and perception no longer furnish a route back to assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Equal warning and non-warning characterize the closed bloc, but the surah immediately and narratively displays another response: following reminder, believing, and hearing with compliance. Aktharihim therefore marks a response partition rather than an undifferentiated human incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Numerical majority leaves logical room for the contrasting hearer.
Equivalence of warning and non-warning defines the unresponsive side of the partition.
Warning normally awakens caution, so its failure diagnoses response rather than lack of address.
A positive declaration of settled belief instantiates the remainder left open by 'most.'
Hearing as understanding and compliance gives the positive response a functional channel.

structural_cues: 36:10 repeats la yu'minun, while 36:11 limits effective warning to one who follows and fears.
36:20-25 stages one man separating from his people by exhorting, believing, and asking to be heard.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unresponsive plural and a believing hearer; I infer the latter as a concrete instance of the remainder implied by aktharihim. Alternatively, the narrative believer may exemplify responsiveness without belonging to the exact audience scoped in 36:7.

changed_reading.before: Most do not believe because the warning is intrinsically ineffective.
changed_reading.after: The same warning sorts hearers by response: it is inert for the closed majority but becomes followable, hearable, and believable for a preserved remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The city narrative turns qawl into an escalating exchange: messengers state their commission, hearers assign lying and threaten, and correction is met by excess. The due word can thus be read as the endpoint of repeated counter-speech that stabilizes a communal stance.

activation_trace.role: Qawl as exchange over an affair opens a dialogic rather than monologic mechanism.
The messengers' articulated claim initiates the contested speech sequence.
Assigning the speakers to falsehood converts reception into explicit counter-speech.
Crossing the limit names the escalation by which rejection becomes entrenched.

structural_cues: 36:14-19 repeatedly alternates qalu with claim, denial, threat, and correction.
36:20-25 interrupts the communal exchange with one dissenting voice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies iterative speech, attribution of lying, and excess; I supply the arrow from repeated counter-speech to stabilization of the majority's stance. The alternative is that the dialogue merely exhibits a verdict already fixed independently.

changed_reading.before: The word falls on a group before its response matters.
changed_reading.after: The word becomes due through a history of answered warning in which repeated denial and escalation harden the majority's own public position.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing deeds and traces, exhaustive counting, sealing mouths, and bodily testimony form an adjudicative chain. The focus word becomes a finding made binding by an evidentiary record, not an unsupported sentence.

activation_trace.role: Establishing and manifesting truth supplies the focus's evidentiary hinge.
The articulated word is the adjudicative conclusion to be established.
Writing that establishes an obligatory judgment turns past action into a binding record.
Exhaustive enumeration closes gaps in the record on which the finding rests.
A preventing seal disables the mouth's ability to control its own account.
Intelligible bodily speech relocates the evidentiary voice from mouth to deed-bearing limbs.
Knowledge-based testimony converts what was done into explicit proof.

structural_cues: 36:12 joins deeds, prior effects, traces, exhaustive counting, and a clear register.
36:54 states exact recompense, and 36:65 replaces sealed oral defense with speaking hands and testifying feet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies record, enumeration, recompense, and testimony; I infer a judicial chain terminating in the focus's binding qawl. A live alternative is that the record and testimony are later confirmations of a decree established on another basis.

changed_reading.before: The binding word is a bare decree imposed from outside.
changed_reading.after: The binding word is also readable as an adjudicative finding whose truth is made inspectable through recorded traces and involuntary testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mock question about when the promise will arrive is answered by a single event and retrospective acknowledgment that the messengers spoke truly. Haqqa al-qawl therefore gains a temporal mechanism: speech reaches its appointed point and becomes occurrence.

activation_trace.role: Due obligation lets the focus word be read as awaiting fulfillment.
Articulated speech supplies the promise-like content that can later be verified.
A promise bounded by a time or place makes the scoffers' 'when' structurally consequential.
Recognized promised speech links the earlier question to fulfilled expectation.
Fulfillment in deed verifies the messengers' prior words.
The single terrifying cry is the event that converts forecast speech into present reality.
Occurrence in time marks the transition from promised content to happened state.

structural_cues: 36:48 asks for the promise's time, while 36:52 answers after awakening that this is what was promised.
36:49 and 36:53 each reduce the transition to one cry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a timed promise, its recognition, and its eventful verification; I infer that promissory temporal logic back into qawl at 36:7. The alternative is that the focus qawl is a verdict rather than the promise itself.

changed_reading.before: The word is already true in a timeless sense.
changed_reading.after: The word becomes due when announced content reaches its appointed event and can no longer be treated as postponable speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: A direct qawl of safety is addressed to the garden group and is immediately followed by separation of the criminal group. The focus's 'most' is thus sharpened as one side of audience-specific verbal allocation, not the fate of every addressee.

activation_trace.role: Majority language supplies the original non-total partition.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the positive outcome assigned to the contrasting audience.
Explicitly articulated qawl makes the positive allocation structurally comparable to the focus word.
Active sorting makes the two audience outcomes visibly distinct.

structural_cues: 36:55-58 addresses the garden companions collectively and culminates in qawl.
36:59 immediately commands the criminals to separate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a positive qawl followed by explicit sorting; I infer these as the counter-allocation to the focus word upon the majority. Alternatively, 36:58 may be a greeting rather than a formal counterpart to 36:7.

changed_reading.before: The focus word is the surah's undifferentiated speech outcome.
changed_reading.after: The focus word belongs to a sorted speech economy: one audience bears the due word, while another receives a word of safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-exact recurrence at 36:70 places the construction inside a bifurcated purpose: warning addresses whoever is alive, while the word becomes due against those who cover the truth. This identifies the focus majority by response-class and keeps warning oriented toward residual life.

activation_trace.role: The original binding construction is the phrase resumed later.
Failure of assent is the focus classification sharpened by the reprise.
Living responsiveness supplies the addressee for whom warning remains functionally open.
The repeated due-word construction explicitly resumes the focus mechanism.
The same articulated-word branch confirms the lexical recurrence.
Covering the truth supplies a functional description of the class against whom the word becomes due.

structural_cues: 36:70 repeats yahiqqa al-qawlu 'ala with the same two focus roots and preposition.
The recurrence is coordinated with warning whoever is alive and follows 36:69's reminder and clear recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact lexical-syntactic reprise and its living-versus-covering split; I infer that the later line interprets the earlier majority. A live alternative is that 36:70 summarizes a broader purpose without making the two scoped groups strictly identical.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified majority happens not to believe.
changed_reading.after: The majority is the truth-covering response-class on whom the word becomes due, contrasted with living responsiveness for which warning remains active.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final willing-command-saying-being chain demonstrates qawl as an event-producing act. It strengthens the baseline possibility that the focus word is operative: once said with authority, it and the state it determines are not separable.

activation_trace.role: The effective say of an authoritative speaker anchors the performative baseline.
Establishing truth supplies the transition from saying to accomplished state.
Command and obligation make speech directive rather than merely descriptive.
Will supplies the initiating intention behind the effective utterance.
Articulated saying is the explicit middle link between will and occurrence.
Immediate occurrence in time is the state produced by the utterance.

structural_cues: 36:82 gives a compact sequence of willing, saying, and being.
36:83 closes with comprehensive dominion and return, preserving the effective speaker's scope.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit will-to-speech-to-occurrence chain; I infer that it illuminates the operative force of qawl in 36:7. The alternative is that creative qawl at 36:82 is a special case and the earlier qawl remains declarative or judicial.

changed_reading.before: The focus word only predicts or labels the majority's state.
changed_reading.after: The focus word can function performatively: authoritative speech establishes the state it names, while still leaving open whether it creates or ratifies that state.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus qawl maps secondarily to q-l-l, not because 'word' should be translated as 'fewness.' It remains packet-anchored through the supplied split mapping and the adjacent aktharihim; downstream prose should present it only as a lexical shadow that accentuates the unspoken minority.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-qawl at word 3 beside aktharihim at word 5.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped root contributes a shadow of fewness within the packet's qawl inventory.
Explicit numerical abundance sets the fewness shadow into a sharp majority-remainder contrast.

changed_reading.before: Most is a loose intensifier and the remainder is silent.
changed_reading.after: The packet lets qawl faintly echo fewness beside 'most,' making the preserved minority unusually audible without changing the lexical translation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the natural agent of the focus word may be external to the majority. It remains anchored in qawl, haqq, and 36:76's explicit 'their speech' across hidden and public registers; downstream prose should qualify it as a secondary evidentiary reading, not replace the decree reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Haqqa al-qawlu 'ala aktharihim, especially qawl at word 3 and 'upon' at word 4.

activation_trace.role: A due obligation allows speech to adhere to and become chargeable upon its bearers.
Speech circulating among people opens a social rather than solely decretal source for the word.
The explicit phrase 'their speech' supplies owned articulated content.
Hidden inward content extends the evidentiary field beneath public utterance.
Manifest public content completes the hidden-visible speech pair.

changed_reading.before: Only an external decree becomes due upon the majority.
changed_reading.after: Their own hidden and public counter-speech may also mature into the word that adheres to them as evidence and consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates haqq's camel-maturity branch as a material analogy. It remains anchored in the focus branch inventory and the surah's timed promise-fulfillment sequence; downstream prose should say the word is 'as if' mature enough to bear its load, never offer that image as a direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Haqqa at word 2 governing al-qawl at word 3.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the stage of bearing and use supplies a material threshold for the word's becoming due.
Articulated speech is the entity imagined as crossing that threshold.
A promise bounded by time supplies the period before the threshold is reached.
Fulfillment in action marks the promised word as now capable of bearing consequence.

changed_reading.before: The word changes status by abstract confirmation alone.
changed_reading.after: The word can be pictured, cautiously, as reaching a load-bearing maturity at which announced consequence becomes executable.

strongest_changes: The immediate collars, barriers, and failed sight turn a bare verdict into embodied perceptual closure.
The exact 36:70 reprise identifies the affected majority by a truth-covering response while preserving warning for living responsiveness.
The promise-fulfillment sequence and the final will-say-be chain give qawl temporal and performative force.
The written record and bodily testimony make the due word readable as an inspectable adjudicative finding.
summary.what_was_special: Across the whole surah, qawl moves through warning, denial, promise, peace, testimony, and creation, while aktharihim keeps a remainder visible; the packet's split qawl-to-q-l-l mapping and haqq maturity branch also preserve two contained readings a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the focus qawl is primarily decree, promise, adjudicative finding, or a category broad enough to carry all three.
Whether the immediate barriers cause nonbelief, enact it, or independently follow the same binding word.
Whether 36:70 strictly identifies the 36:7 majority or supplies a broader reprise.
The fewness shadow and load-bearing maturity image are packet-licensed but deliberately form-distant.
